name: Quantum ESPRESSO
description: Builds Quantum ESPRESSO 7.6 into /opt/wise with the image's MPI, FFTW, ScaLAPACK and OpenBLAS. With cudaCC it builds the GPU version with nvfortran, OpenACC, cuFFT and cuSOLVER from the CUDA base image's HPC SDK.

cudaCC.description: GPU compute capability for nvfortran (-gpu=ccXX); requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU version with GCC.
